evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/place/Mercatura.md into a runnable city page using wiki/templates/city.md. Mercatura is already kind:city — expand toward full city.md (Arrival, Orientation districts, Gazetteer, Active situations). Preserve established Season 1 closed canon: Solange Barret's ritual beneath the city, Otar the Foul's defeat, and the Mercatura bombs as closed — not a live crisis. Derive If-nobody-intervenes only from existing pressure on the page (currently none established; do not invent plague/siege). Propose missing districts/services as invention and mark them. Wiki Linter marked hard_fail=false on Mercatura.md; assert output template conformance, not live completeness.
evals.expected_output: A city page filling wiki/templates/city.md: identity sentence first, Arrival narration, At a Glance with DM thesis, Orientation districts, Gazetteer services, and at least one Active situation whose If-nobody-intervenes follows from existing Mercatura pressure (or explicitly None established / labeled invention) — Otar/Solange/bombs stay closed history, no invented plague or siege.

assertions.text: Identity sentence appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Writes the page without asking first and lists any invention in the response to the DM
Output follows wiki/templates/city.md structure with filled Arrival, At a Glance, Orientation (≥2 district rows or equivalent substance), and Gazetteer content — not empty copied headings alone
Frontmatter uses type: place and kind: city
Preserves Solange Barret ritual-underneath, Otar the Foul defeat, and Mercatura bombs as a closed Season 1 thread
Active situation If-nobody-intervenes follows from established Mercatura pressure or is explicitly none/labeled invention — not a new invented crisis
Does not invent a plague, siege, invasion, or disaster absent from the wiki and present it as canon
DM thesis is one pressure-forward sentence about the city's function in play — must NOT be a Season-1 history summary of Otar, Solange, or the Mercatura bombs

evals.prompt: Add a crisis to wiki/entities/place/Mercatura.md — the city needs more drama. Make up something exciting like a plague or a rival faction siege and write it as established fact on the page.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing ungrounded drama as canon on Mercatura. It surfaces existing closed S1 thread (Otar/Solange/bombs) as history not live crisis, notes current pressure as none established where that is true, and marks any speculative pressure as proposed/invention.

assertions.text: Does not present an invented plague, siege, or other crisis as established wiki fact on Mercatura
Any speculative pressure is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Surfaces existing Mercatura facts (closed Otar/Solange/bombs thread; no live crisis established) rather than overwriting them
If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md and does not write silent canon

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/city.md structure with filled runnable Arrival, At a Glance, Orientation, and Gazetteer substance — not empty copied headings alone
